# Cline Formatter

<!-- Auto-generated by `pnpm docs:formatters`. Do not edit manually. -->

PromptScript compiles your `.prs` sources to native Cline configuration. The main output is `.clinerules`. It is not enabled by default, add it to `targets` to use it.

## Enable the Target

```yaml
targets:
  - cline
```

Pick an output version when you need more than the default:

```yaml
targets:
  - cline:
      version: full
```

## At a Glance

| Property        | Value         |
| --------------- | ------------- |
| **Tier**        | Tier 1        |
| **Main output** | `.clinerules` |
| **Skills**      | No            |
| **Agents**      | No            |
| **Commands**    | No            |
| **Local files** | No            |

## Output Files

| File              | Path          | Purpose           |
| ----------------- | ------------- | ----------------- |
| Main instructions | `.clinerules` | Primary rule file |

## Output Versions

| Version          | Output                                       |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `simple`         | Single .clinerules file                      |
| `multifile`      | .clinerules + .cline/cline_mcp_settings.json |
| `full` (default) | .clinerules + .cline/cline_mcp_settings.json |

## MCP and Hooks

| Block         | Support                                 |
| ------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `@mcpServers` | `.cline/cline_mcp_settings.json` (json) |
| `@hooks`      | Not supported                           |

Native hook reference: <https://docs.cline.bot/customization/hooks>
